note: Shared list of Agent Finders (discovery services) the connectors can search, each with a name. The agentfinder skill seeds this into ~/.agentfinder/finders.json on first use, shows it as a menu, and remembers the user's pick in `selected`. Add your own finders to the `finders` array; set `selected` to a finder's `id` to skip the menu. Every public ARD discovery service known at the time of writing is listed, in alphabetical order by id; none is preselected.

finders.name: ARD Registry
finders.description: A public directory for the ARD specification. Serves search at /api/search rather than the spec's /search.

finders.name: Desvela ARD Registry
finders.description: Independent ARD registry, with tooling for checking what a domain publishes for agents.

finders.name: GitHub Agent Finder
finders.description: GitHub's public catalog of installable MCP servers, skills, and tools.

finders.name: Hugging Face Discover
finders.description: Hugging Face's discovery service. Indexes Hugging Face Spaces, Skills and MCP server cards.

finders.name: Neuronto
finders.description: Federated index. Searches its own catalogue plus every other public ARD registry in this list and fuses the rankings, so one query covers the whole federation. Also indexes tools read from each MCP server's own tools/list.

finders.name: WellKnown
finders.description: ARD catalog census. Crawls well-known manifests across the web.
